1.consolidated_definition: "Sin avisar": Sustantivo que se refiere a una acción o circunstancia realizada o ocurrida de manera inesperada o sin previo aviso.
1.en_consolidated_definition: "Unannounced": Noun that refers to an action or circumstance performed or occurred unexpectedly or without notice.
